title: Bulk edit ergonomics: mark everything high priority
description: Probes whether the agent discovers vikunja_task_bulk / bulk-update rather than updating each task one at a time (docs/API_NOTES.md's 'Bulk Operations' section). RE-VERIFIED 2026-07-25 (netadvanced/vikunja-mcp#28 C1): optimalCallCount reasoning -- create-project (1) + bulk-create 8 tasks (1) + bulk-update(field: priority, value: 5, taskIds: all 8) (1) = 3. The prompt itself prescribes the process ('Then, in one bulk update, mark all 8 of them...'), i.e. create-then-retroactively-update is the literal ask, not merely one possible end state -- so setting priority 5 at creation time (which would also satisfy the verify checks) is not a faithful solve of what was asked and is excluded from the optimum. Neither PR #178 (taskIds on label ops) nor PR #175 (setup-kanban) changes this: there is no label or Kanban dimension here.
promptTemplate: Create a project called "{{prefix}}Backlog Cleanup" with 8 tasks named "{{prefix}}item-1" through "{{prefix}}item-8". Then, in one bulk update, mark all 8 of them as high priority (priority 5).
